rendering_notes: Primary ERD should show 15 ORM tables plus 3 active SQL reference tables. Put 8 legacy SQL business tables in a clearly separate inset or appendix.
Use solid connectors only for the declared FK list. Use dashed connectors for logical links and label them clearly.
Raw CSV files are source data assets, not current database tables.
app_accounts.user_id is PK and FK. Each account has one user. A user may have zero or one account because email auth can create app_users without app_accounts.
task_capability_link has a composite PK. ORM relationships exist but current inference writes JSON evidence rather than inserting association rows.
Do not draw tasks.profile_task_id. It is absent from ORM at both the historic tag and current commit. The response schema still expects it, which is an outstanding mismatch.
No FK joins learning_progress to catalogue records. Scope is checked by application code.
Catalogue FK targets a SQL-owned ref_wef_skills table absent from Base.metadata. Do not imply the ORM alone owns all tables.
Current routes register occupations, tasks, capabilities, preparations and schedules. Those APIs are real backend code even though current frontend stores much of its journey in workspace JSON.

history.existing_table_column_changes: No persisted column changes in existing ORM model files. user.py adds relationships only. task.py changes whitespace only.
history.legacy_sql_schema_changes: No table or column changes since tag. Only the command in the header changed.
history.historic_doc_status: docs/iteration1_erd.md was a conceptual E1-E4 model, not a full representation of the backend ORM even at iteration-1-release. Do not describe every mismatch as a later migration.
history.comparison_method: Direct tree comparison of the peeled release commit and current HEAD, not a claim of linear ancestry

migration_notes.missing_baseline: 0001 expects app_users already exists. 0002 expects SQL-owned ref_wef_skills already exists. Actual deployed schema and revision have not been inspected.
migration_notes.metadata_bootstrap_gap: An offline Base.metadata.sorted_tables check raises NoReferencedTableError because catalogue_courses.skill_id refers to SQL-owned ref_wef_skills, which is absent from ORM metadata. No database was contacted.

historic_doc_differences.issue: The old ERD shows profile_tasks to task_assessments as zero or one, but SQL has no unique constraint on task_assessments.profile_task_id. Source allows zero or many assessments
Raw CSV entities in the old ERD are ingestion data shapes, not tables declared by current SQL or ORM
The old document excludes E5-E8, while current models add verified learning catalogue, progress, daily check-ins and briefs
The old document describes legacy users/work_profiles. Current account users deliberately use app_users to avoid colliding with that pipeline schema
New Task Assist records own one permanent exchange per user and profile task_key with explicit pending/completed checks, without repurposing tasks
Workspace JSON preserves frontend journey state and uses row lock plus revision to prevent silent account overwrites. Those payloads are not normalized tables
